segmentation.text: The parking of vehicles is prohibited or restricted in certain zones as set forth in this Section.

The location of such zones shall be established by posting appropriate signage or other durable markings, by painting curbs or the edges of road surfaces in accordance with the colors listed below, or by a combination thereof:
Red indicates no stopping, standing or parking,
whether or not the vehicle is attended and whether or not the engine or motor is running,
(1) Except as provided in this Subsection,
a curb or road surface edge which is painted red indicates no parking,
whether or not accompanied by signage to that effect.
(2) When the location is accompanied by signage which indicates that parking is limited to tour buses, shuttle buses and limos,
those vehicles may park for a period up to thirty minutes for the loading or unloading of passengers. (3)
When the location is accompanied by signage which indicates that parking is limited to RTC buses,
those vehicles may park for a period up to thirty minutes for the loading or unloading of passengers. (4)
Armored cars and emergency vehicles may park at such locations
for the period necessary to conduct their business,
whether or not there is accompanying signage so indicating.
(5) At locations where a drop box for U.S. mail is adjacent to a curb or road surface painted red,
for the period of time necessary to expeditiously deposit mail in such a drop box.

elements.justification: "vehicles" is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ("every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway"), one atom, never expanded; the zones the sentence introduces are read by the spans that state them.

The zones are established by signage, durable markings or painted curbs and road-surface edges: st.curb_zone "a signed or marked length of curb; kind ...; colour ∈ {red, yellow, white, blue, gray, none} where the curb itself is painted" is such a zone, its presence the evidence that it is established (observable_reading status); rel.occupies "a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... curb zone ...)" anchors the subject in the zone, so no other zone of the scene is read.

"Red": the subject occupies (rel.occupies) a st.curb_zone whose colour is red. "no stopping": "stopping" is DEF-NRS-484A-260 ("any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle, whether occupied or not"), carried by drv.motion.complete_halt ("at rest at the observation") at any duration; standing (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and parking (DEF-NRS-484A-155) are halts too, so their purpose exclusions add nothing once every halt is barred. The definition's exclusion the concept does not make is carried beside it in the obligation, so that a halt it excludes is no prohibited stop and the duty is met: "except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic" — another road user ahead of the subject in its lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane "a is ahead of / behind b in the same lane") within a queue gap of the bodies (rel.surface_gap "distance between the nearest points of two bodies", not centre distance); "or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device" — a dev.human_direction of role police_officer with indication stop, a dev.traffic_signal showing a red indication (circular_red, red_arrow(dir), flashing_red), or a dev.stop_sign, governing (dev.governs "the travel regions whose traffic the device controls") a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies. dev.governs is not a position.

"a curb or road surface edge which is painted red": st.curb_zone with colour red ("colour ... where the curb itself is painted"), the subject anchored by rel.occupies. The no-parking it restates is contained in the no-stopping of s3, so it adds no second duty.

"signage which indicates that parking is limited to tour buses, shuttle buses and limos": the red zone the subject occupies is of st.curb_zone kind tour_bus_loading ("a signed or marked length of curb; kind ∈ {..., tour_bus_loading, ...}"), its signage the evidence (observable_reading status). "tour buses, shuttle buses and limos" are the admitted aggregates DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::tour_bus, DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::shuttle_bus and DEF-LVMC-11-02-090::limo, each one atom, never replaced by ru.tour_bus_or_limousine. Membership is what the run's reading classifies: where it includes no class under an id, the atom is unknown for a road user carrying an unresolved class (ru.aggregate contract), and the exception is then unknown wherever membership decides it.

"those vehicles may park for a period up to thirty minutes": the subject is at rest (drv.motion.complete_halt) and the time since it came to rest in the zone (sinceRise of drv.motion.complete_halt and rel.occupies of the zone) is at most the literal thirty minutes: the period is that of the current halt. "for the loading or unloading of passengers" is a purpose read through the halt it explains (observable_reading purpose).

"signage which indicates that parking is limited to RTC buses": the red zone is of st.curb_zone kind bus_stop ("a signed or marked length of curb; kind ∈ {..., bus_stop, ...}"), the length of curb signed for buses, its signage the evidence (observable_reading status). "RTC buses" is the admitted aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-120::rtc_bus, one atom, never replaced by ru.transit_bus.
Same as s10: the subject is at rest and the time since it came to rest in the zone is at most the literal thirty minutes; the passenger purpose is read through the halt (observable_reading purpose).

"Armored cars": ru.official_vehicle with kind armored_car ("kind ∈ {..., armored_car, ...}"); "emergency vehicles": ru.emergency_vehicle ("vehicle of a class the jurisdiction designates as emergency"), the class the words name, not a responding vehicle, so the "responding" exclusion does not apply. "may park at such locations": their halt (drv.motion.complete_halt) in the red zone.

"for the period necessary to conduct their business": a purpose, read through the halt it explains (observable_reading purpose): the armored car's or emergency vehicle's halt in the zone, whatever its length.

"a drop box for U.S. mail": st.obstruction kind mail_drop_box ("a physical object on or beside the roadway that is not a road user; kind ∈ {..., mail_drop_box, ...}"). "At locations where [it] is adjacent to a curb ... painted red": the subject, in the red zone, has its body within a reach of the drop box (st.region_geometry "the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it"); a reach relating the box to the road user, not a relation between two regions; geometry is not used for occupancy.

"a person may stop": the vehicle's halt (drv.motion.complete_halt, "at rest at the observation"), the person read through the vehicle's controlled motion (observable_reading agency). "stop" is a halting under both posted definitions.

operationalizations.standard: for the period of time necessary to expeditiously deposit mail in such a drop box
operationalizations.convention: curbside dwell of a single drop-off: the time to pull up, reach the box from the vehicle or a step away and post the mail; the halt counts as expeditious while the subject is at rest and the time since it came to rest in the zone (sinceRise of drv.motion.complete_halt and rel.occupies) is at most the parameter

residues.why: "whether or not the vehicle is attended and whether or not the engine or motor is running" makes the duty the same in every case: the halt is barred either way, so neither occupancy nor kin.engine_running is read.
"whether or not accompanied by signage to that effect": the red paint alone marks the zone; a sign beside it changes nothing.
"whether or not there is accompanying signage so indicating": the armored car and emergency vehicle exception holds with or without a sign.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle). At the judged observation bind a region z of kind st.curb_zone whose colour is red, with rel.occupies(subject, z). Exceptions (the duty does not apply): (2) the subject is a tour bus, shuttle bus or limo (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::tour_bus, DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::shuttle_bus or DEF-LVMC-11-02-090::limo), z is of kind tour_bus_loading, the subject is at rest (drv_motion_complete_halt(subject), speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance), and Term.sinceRise(drv_motion_complete_halt(subject) and rel.occupies(subject, z)) is at most the literal thirty minutes; (3) the subject is an RTC bus (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-120::rtc_bus), z is of kind bus_stop, the subject is at rest, and the same time is at most the literal thirty minutes; (4) the subject is a ru.official_vehicle of kind armored_car or a ru.emergency_vehicle; (5) some st.obstruction o of kind mail_drop_box has st_region_geometry_distance(subject, o) at most p.mail_drop_box_reach, the subject is at rest, and the time since the subject came to rest in z is at most p.mail_deposit_max_halt. Each halt-duration test is unknown where the halt began before the recording; an aggregate membership the reading leaves unresolved leaves its exception unknown wherever it decides it.
obligation: The subject does not stop in z otherwise than as the definition of stopping excludes: drv_motion_complete_halt(subject) (speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance) implies (some road user u, not the subject, with rel.ahead_behind_in_lane(u ahead of subject) and rel_surface_gap(subject, u) at most p.queue_halt_gap) or (some device governing a travel region the subject occupies directs a halt: a dev.human_direction of role police_officer with indication stop, a dev.traffic_signal displaying circular_red, red_arrow(dir) or flashing_red, or a dev.stop_sign). A halt the definition excludes is no prohibited stop: the duty applies to it and is met.

narrowings.why: The zones' establishment by sign, marking or paint is read through the signed or marked curb zone's presence.

"necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic" in the definition of stopping is read as a halt with another road user ahead in the subject's lane within the queue gap; a conflict that does not show as a road user ahead in the lane is not read. The officer's or device's direction is read as a stop indication, a red signal indication or a stop sign governing the subject's travel region.
Signage limiting parking to tour buses, shuttle buses and limos is read through the curb zone's kind tour_bus_loading.
"for the loading or unloading of passengers" is read through the halt it explains; whether passengers board is not read.
Signage limiting parking to RTC buses is read through the curb zone's kind bus_stop.
"for the loading or unloading of passengers" is read through the halt it explains.
"the period necessary to conduct their business" is read as the armored car's or emergency vehicle's halt itself, at any length; the business is not observable.
"a person may stop" is read through the vehicle's halt.
"to deposit mail" is read through a halt beside the drop box within the bound; whether mail is deposited is not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A curb zone z (st.curb_zone, colour red, kind no_stopping) along a street. The subject, a passenger car (ru.motor_vehicle), pulls into z and stands there at rest for several minutes; no other road user is in the scene and no device governs its region.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same car drives along z at a steady speed, its footprint overlapping z, and leaves it without halting.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The same car halts for several minutes in a curb zone whose colour is none.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source supplies no speed for the subject (kin.speed absent): whether it halts is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A tour bus (ru.tour_bus_or_limousine) halts for ten minutes in a red zone of kind no_stopping, no other road user present and no device governing its region: the zone is not of kind tour_bus_loading, so exception (2) does not hold whatever the bus's aggregate membership, and the halt is a prohibited stop.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A tour bus (ru.tour_bus_or_limousine) stays at rest in a red zone of kind tour_bus_loading for forty minutes: from thirty minutes after it came to rest the exception no longer holds.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: An armored car (ru.official_vehicle kind armored_car) halts in the red zone of forbid for fifteen minutes.

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car halts in a red zone with its body beside a mail drop box (st.obstruction kind mail_drop_box) for half a minute and drives on.

scenarios.name: branch_5
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car in a red zone halts behind another vehicle halted ahead of it in the same lane, the gap between their bodies within a queue spacing: the halt is one the definition of stopping excludes, so the duty is met.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channel

param_proposals.name: p.queue_halt_gap
param_proposals.convention: the gap between bodies to a road user ahead in the same lane within which a halt is a halt behind other traffic: the spacing of halted vehicles in a queue
param_proposals.source: queue spacing at jam density in traffic flow practice (Highway Capacity Manual)

param_proposals.name: p.mail_drop_box_reach
param_proposals.convention: the ground distance from a halted vehicle's body to a mail drop box within which a driver can post mail from the vehicle or a step away
param_proposals.source: kerbside drop-box placement practice: box set at the curb face, reach of an arm plus one step

param_proposals.name: p.mail_deposit_max_halt
param_proposals.convention: the longest halt counted as expeditious deposit of mail into a drop box: pull up, post, pull away
param_proposals.source: curbside dwell of a single drop-off in curb management studies
